To assess business and operational requirements and translate them into practical digital solutions that improve maintenance operations, process efficiency, and productivity. The role is responsible for developing, customizing, integrating, and supporting applications, automated workflows, reporting solutions, and maintenance systems using technologies such as Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SQL, APIs, CMMS, Rockwell Automation and related development tools.

Working closely with Maintenance, Operations, IT, and other business teams, the role will identify process gaps, automate manual activities, improve maintenance and spare-parts management, integrate digital solutions with ERP and other enterprise systems, and support the testing and implementation of Smart Crane and other industrial digital solutions in accordance with Fives IT policies, cybersecurity requirements, and applicable standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience.
Good understanding of maintenance operations, equipment and spare-parts management processes; experience with cranes or other industrial equipment would be advantageous.
Knowledge and hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps & Power Automate), Power BI, Microsoft SQL Server, and database technologies.
Knowledge and experience in application development, APIs, system integration, and programming tools.
Knowledge of CMMS / Maintenance Management Systems, such as COSWIN or equivalent platforms.
Understanding of ERP systems and integration, preferably SAP Business One or similar platforms.
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, cloud-based applications, and databases is advantageous.
Understanding of maintenance operations, spare-parts management, and industrial digital solutions is highly desirable.
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Relevant Microsoft Azure, SQL, or Application Development certification is advantageous.
Occasional regional/international travel may be required

By becoming part of Fives, you will join an international group offering access to a wide range of growth and mobility opportunities. We provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and develop both professionally and personally.
r: Work closely with Maintenance, Operations, and business teams to understand requirements, identify process gaps, and implement practical digital solutions that improve productivity, efficiency, and operational visibility.
Analyze existing processes and identify opportunities for digitalization, workflow automation, and reduction of manual activities.
Translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions and continuously improve implemented applications based on operational needs and user feedback.

Design, develop, customize, and maintain applications and automated workflows using Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SQL, APIs, web technologies, and other appropriate development tools.
Develop reporting, approvals, notifications, workflows, and system integrations to improve operational processes and information flow.
Perform application configuration, development, testing, troubleshooting, bug fixing, and enhancement of existing digital solutions.

Support and optimize COSWIN CMMS or equivalent maintenance systems, covering equipment records, work orders, preventive maintenance, spare-parts consumption, Spare part cost reports, stock visibility, and maintenance reporting.
Improve the flow of maintenance and inventory information between CMMS, ERP, reporting platforms, and other operational systems.

Analyze spare-parts and stock consumption to ensure material issues recorded within maintenance activities are accurately captured and reconciled with the ERP inventory system, identifying discrepancies and implementing improvements to strengthen inventory accuracy and control.
Support digital solutions that improve spare-parts tracking, consumption control, maintenance planning, and asset visibility.
Develop and support integrations between maintenance systems, ERP applications, databases, and third-party solutions using APIs, SQL, middleware, and other integration technologies.
Identify data and process gaps between Maintenance, Inventory, ERP, and other systems and implement solutions that improve data consistency and operational workflows.
Coordinate with IT teams, vendors, and solution providers where specialized development or external support is required.
Support the implementation, testing, integration, and continuous improvement of Smart Crane and other industrial digital solutions.
Participate in proof-of-concepts, functional testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment of new technologies and digital tools.
Support operational data collection, integration, visualization, and reporting to improve maintenance and operational decision-making.
Troubleshoot application, workflow, database, interface, and integration issues and coordinate resolution where additional technical support is required.
Support solutions throughout their lifecycle from requirements gathering and development through testing, deployment, user acceptance, and post-implementation support.
Maintain technical documentation, process maps, user guides, and operating procedures and provide training to ensure effective user adoption.
Ensure digital applications and integrations comply with Fives IT, cybersecurity, data protection, HSEQ, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend opportunities to improve maintenance performance, automate processes, and increase operational efficiency.
Support continuous improvement and digital transformation initiatives by identifying where technology can simplify or enhance existing operations.
